args.body:
Summary of websites posted in 'general':
1) www.informations.com: Latest job report brought mixed relief and concern as unemployment edged down to 7.2%.
2) www.restaurant-zurich.com: Zurich Restaurant is a cozy, alpine-inspired eatery in the city center known for authentic Swiss cuisine (cheese fondue, rösti, chocolate fondue), with warm wooden interiors, panoramic skyline views and friendly staff in traditional Swiss attire.
Hi Eve! I enjoyed your blog. Hiking is a great topic. The page is clear but quite short, so adding hiking stories, photos, favorite trails and tips would make it more engaging. Nice start!

Hi Dora! I visited your personal website. It's clean and simple, and it's good that your contact email is easy to find. It would be stronger with more content, such as an about section, your projects or interests, and some visuals. Great start!
